title: Hastings did not systematically ask witnesses whether they saw beings

tellings.quote: this conversation with Bob Hastings in the past where I say, "Did you did you systematically ask all of the whistleblowers who just seen crafts whether they've seen beings themselves?" And he said, "No."

related.note: This is the same conversation between Jesse and Hastings about how many witnesses saw beings, but here Hastings says he never asked them systematically instead of giving a count.

plain: Robert Hastings is a researcher who has gathered accounts from former military men who saw UFOs at nuclear weapons sites. Michels says he once asked Hastings whether he had gone back to all the witnesses who saw only craft and asked each of them whether they had also seen beings, and Hastings told him no. Michels raises it to suggest that encounters with beings may be more common among these witnesses than the counts show, since nobody asked.
